block.description: you get a `block` value from events like `PlayerInteract`, `BlockBreak`, `BlockPlace`, `ProjectileHit`, and `BlockExplode`

methods.name: setType
methods.description: sets the block to a target material
methods.example: block.setType("glass") // sets the block to glass

parameters.name: material
parameters.description: case insensitive vanilla block material name string

entity.description: you get an `entity` value from `Katton.world().entities`, or as the return value of `Katton.world().spawnEntity(...)`. players are **not** included here, they're exposed separately via `player` values (see [player](https://www.google.com/search?q=player.md)) and `Katton.world().players`

properties.name: is_valid
properties.description: true / false. an entity can stop existing at any point, whether it dies, despawns, etc. once that happens, every method below (other than the properties) throws a runtime error so check first if the `entity` value still exists

properties.name: tags
properties.description: a list of scoreboard tag strings

properties.name: vehicle
properties.description: a `entity` value for whatever they are riding

methods.name: setHealth
methods.description: sets the entity's current health
methods.note: living entities only. value is clamped between `0` and the entity's `max_health`

methods.name: setDisplayName
methods.description: sets the custom name tag displayed above the entity
methods.note: passing `""` hides the name tag

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: custom display text, supports `&` color codes

methods.name: setSkin
methods.description: sets the entity's skin if the entity is a mannequin
methods.note: only works on mannequins

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: changes the skin of a mannequin to this username

methods.name: teleport
methods.description: teleports the entity to a target location object

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: location object `{ x, y, z, yaw, pitch }`

methods.name: setGlowing
methods.description: enables or disables the vanilla outline glowing effect around the entity

parameters.name: glowing
parameters.description: whether the glowing effect should be active

methods.name: addTag
methods.description: adds a scoreboard tag to the entity
methods.note: scoreboard tags are handy for marking specific entities your script spawned so you can tell them apart from everything else in the world later

methods.name: removeTag
methods.description: removes a scoreboard tag from the entity
methods.note: `removeTag` does nothing if the tag was never there

methods.name: hasTag
methods.description: checks if the entity has a scoreboard tag

methods.name: setMovementSpeed
methods.description: modifies movement speed attribute base values
methods.note: living entities only

parameters.name: speed
parameters.description: movement speed attribute base value (vanilla default is `0.1`)

methods.name: resetMovementSpeed
methods.description: resets movement speed attribute base values to default
methods.note: living entities only

methods.name: setJumpStrength
methods.description: modifies jump height attribute base values
methods.note: living entities only

parameters.name: strength
parameters.description: jump strength attribute base value (vanilla default is `0.42`)

methods.name: resetJumpStrength
methods.description: resets jump height attribute base values to default
methods.note: living entities only

methods.name: setScale
methods.description: resizes the display entity along each coordinate axis or modifies the living entity's scale attribute
methods.note: only works on display entities for 3 axis scale, or living entities for attribute scale

methods.name: resetScale
methods.description: resets the scale configuration back to default

methods.name: setText
methods.description: sets the text content displayed by a text display entity
methods.note: only works on text display entities (`text_display`)

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: text content string, automatically filtered and styled

methods.name: setBackgroundColor
methods.description: changes the background color of a text display entity
methods.note: only works on text display entities (`text_display`)

methods.name: resetBackground
methods.description: resets the background color of a text display entity
methods.note: only works on text display entities (`text_display`)

methods.name: setDefaultBackground
methods.description: configures whether the default background is enabled for a text display entity
methods.note: only works on text display entities (`text_display`)

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.description: whether the default background is enabled

methods.name: setTextOpacity
methods.description: sets the opacity of the text on a text display entity
methods.note: only works on text display entities (`text_display`)

methods.name: setAlignment
methods.description: sets the text alignment on a text display entity
methods.note: only works on text display entities (`text_display`)

parameters.name: alignment
parameters.description: alignment string, must be one of: left, center, right

methods.name: setLineWidth
methods.description: sets the maximum line width for wrapping text on a text display entity
methods.note: only works on text display entities (`text_display`)

methods.name: setSeeThrough
methods.description: enables or disables whether the text display is visible through blocks
methods.note: only works on text display entities (`text_display`)

methods.name: setShadowed
methods.description: enables or disables the text shadow effect on a text display entity
methods.note: only works on text display entities (`text_display`)

methods.name: setBillboard
methods.description: sets the billboard setting of the text display entity
methods.note: only works on text display entities (`text_display`)

methods.name: setItem
methods.description: sets the item stack displayed by an item display entity
methods.note: only works on item display entities (`item_display`). see item for making items

methods.name: setBlock
methods.description: sets the block material displayed by a block display entity
methods.note: only works on block display entities (`block_display`)

methods.name: setOffset
methods.description: shifts the display entity relative to the entity's actual pivot point without moving the entity itself
methods.note: only works on display entities (`item_display`, `block_display`, `text_display`)

methods.name: setRotation
methods.description: rotates the display model using degrees
methods.note: only works on display entities (`item_display`, `block_display`, `text_display`)

parameters.name: yaw
parameters.description: horizontal rotation around the vertical Y axis (left / right)

parameters.name: pitch
parameters.description: vertical tilt around the X axis (up / down)

parameters.name: roll
parameters.description: sideways tilt around the Z axis

methods.name: setTeleportDuration
methods.description: sets the teleport tick duration for position changes to transition smoothly instead of snapping immediately
methods.note: only works on display entities (`item_display`, `block_display`, `text_display`)

parameters.name: ticks
parameters.description: transition duration in ticks (clamped between `0` and `59`)

methods.name: setInterpolationDuration
methods.description: sets the interpolation duration
methods.note: only works on display entities (`item_display`, `block_display`, `text_display`)

methods.name: setInterpolationDelay
methods.description: sets the interpolation delay
methods.note: only works on display entities (`item_display`, `block_display`, `text_display`)

methods.name: giveEffect
methods.description: gives the entity a potion effect

methods.name: removeEffect
methods.description: removes a specific potion effect from the entity

methods.name: removeAllEffects
methods.description: removes all active potion effects from the entity

methods.name: mount
methods.description: makes the entity mount an entity

methods.name: dismount
methods.description: makes the entity stop riding whatever they are currently riding

methods.name: kill
methods.description: removes the entity immediately from the world

item.description: you can make custom item stacks using `Katton.item(...)` and manipulate their display names, lore, custom tags, enchantments, or clone them

properties.name: setName
properties.description: sets the custom display name of the item stack

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: custom item display name, supports `&` color codes

methods.name: setLore
methods.description: sets the lore description lines on the item stack
methods.example: wand.setLore(["&7Right click to leap forward!", "&7Cooldown: none"])

parameters.name: lines
parameters.description: a list of string lines, supports `&` color codes

methods.name: setTag
methods.description: applies custom data stored directly on the item's metadata
methods.note: tag values are always stored and read back as strings
methods.example:
val wand = Katton.item("stick")
wand.setName("&aLeap Wand")
wand.setTag("ability", "leap_wand") // mark this specific item
sender.give(wand)

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: reads custom data stored directly on the item's metadata
methods.note: `getTag` returns `null` if the tag was never set on that item

methods.name: enchant
methods.description: applies a vanilla enchantment to the item stack
methods.note: passing an unknown enchantment name throws a runtime error

methods.name: clone
methods.description: creates a duplicate copy of the item stack with all its current properties and custom tags preserved
methods.example:
val original = Katton.item("stick")
original.setName("&aOriginal")
val copy = original.clone()
copy.setName("&bCopy")

methods.name: dye
methods.description: dyes a leather armor item

player.description: you get a `player` value from `Katton.players.*` selectors, the `sender` parameter in a command handler, or `event.player` in an event handler

properties.name: location
properties.example: player.location // { x: 12.5, y: 64.0, z: -3.0, yaw: 90.0, pitch: 0.0 }

properties.name: vehicle
properties.description: a `entity` value for whatever they are riding

properties.name: facing
properties.description: tells you which direction the player is looking, as a number: 1 (down), 2 (up), 3 (north), 4 (south), 5 (west), 6 (east)
properties.note: up/down is only reported when the player is looking mostly straight up or down, otherwise you get whichever cardinal direction (N/S/E/W) they're mostly facing

properties.name: tool
properties.description: an `item` value for whatever's in their main hand (empty hand still gives you an item value, just air)

methods.name: setArmor
methods.description: sets an item to the player's armor slot
methods.note: the avialable armor slots are: head/helmet, chest/chestplate, legs/leggings, feet/boots

methods.name: getArmor
methods.description: gets the item in the specified armor slot

methods.name: countItem
methods.description: number of that material in inventory (incl. armor/offhand)

methods.name: setGamemode
methods.description: changes a player gamemode
methods.note: survival/adventure sets them to survival if placing/breaking/building is on, if not it sets them to adventure

parameters.name: gamemode
parameters.description: changes a player's gamemode to: survival/adventure, creative, spectator

methods.name: setHealth
methods.description: sets the player's current health

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: sends a chat message to the player

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: chat message text, supports `&` color codes

methods.name: sendTitle
methods.description: displays a optional title and optional subtitle on the player's screen
methods.example:
player.sendTitle("&cRED", "") // shows RED in red on the top line and nothing on the bottom
player.sendTitle("&eGet Ready!", "&7Round starting...") // shows Get Ready! in yellow on top and Round starting on bottom

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: top line title text, supports `&` color codes

parameters.name: subtitle
parameters.description: bottom line subtitle text, supports `&` color codes

methods.name: setCompassTarget
methods.description: sets the target location for the player's compass

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: location object `{ x, y, z, yaw, pitch }`

methods.name: sendActionBar
methods.description: displays text above the player's hotbar
methods.example: player.sendActionBar("&emoooooo") // shows moooooo in yellow on the actionbar

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: action bar text, supports `&` color codes

methods.name: teleport
methods.description: teleports the player to a target location object

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: location object `{ x, y, z, yaw, pitch }`

methods.name: give
methods.description: adds an item to the player's inventory
methods.note: see item for making items

methods.name: setTool
methods.description: replaces whatever item is currently held in that hand slot
methods.note: replaces whatever's currently in that hand, it doesn't add to the inventory like `give` does

methods.name: setOffhandTool
methods.description: replaces whatever item is currently held in that hand slot
methods.note: replaces whatever's currently in that hand, it doesn't add to the inventory like `give` does

methods.name: playSound
methods.description: plays a sound effect directly to the player
methods.note: you can find all valid sound names at: https://jd.papermc.io/paper/1.21.11/org/bukkit/Sound.html

methods.name: launchForward
methods.description: launches the player in the direction they are currently facing
methods.note: maximum value for both horizontal and vertical speed is `6.0`

methods.name: setVelocity
methods.description: sets the player's velocity

methods.name: giveEffect
methods.description: gives the player a potion effect

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: the amount of time it should last

methods.name: removeEffect
methods.description: removes a specific potion effect from the player

methods.name: removeAllEffects
methods.description: removes all active potion effects from a player

methods.name: clearInventory
methods.description: wipes the player's entire inventory
methods.note: wipes everything, including equipped armor and offhand slots

methods.name: setGlowing
methods.description: enables or disables the vanilla outline glowing effect around the player

parameters.name: glowing
parameters.description: whether the glowing effect should be active

methods.name: setMovementSpeed
methods.description: modifies or resets the player's walking movement speed attribute

parameters.name: speed
parameters.description: movement speed attribute base value (vanilla default is `0.1`)

methods.name: resetMovementSpeed
methods.description: modifies or resets the player's walking movement speed attribute

methods.name: setJumpStrength
methods.description: modifies or resets the player's jump height attribute

parameters.name: strength
parameters.description: jump strength attribute base value (vanilla default is `0.42`)

methods.name: resetJumpStrength
methods.description: modifies or resets the player's jump height attribute

methods.name: setScale
methods.description: modifies the player's scale attribute

methods.name: resetScale
methods.description: resets the player's scale attribute to 1.0

methods.name: setInvulnerable
methods.description: toggles godmode damage immunity for the player
methods.example:
player.setInvulnerable(true) // immune to all damage
player.setInvulnerable(false)

parameters.name: invulnerable
parameters.description: whether the player should be immune to all damage

methods.name: mount
methods.description: makes the player mount a entity

methods.name: dismount
methods.description: makes the player stop riding whatever they are currently riding

methods.name: shootProjectile
methods.description: shoots a projectile from the player in the direction they are currently facing
methods.note: maximum `speed` value is `6.0`

world.description: you interact with the world using `Katton.world()`

properties.name: players
properties.description: a list of `player` values in the game

properties.name: entities
properties.description: every nonplayer entity currently in the world, as a list of entity values. use `world.players` instead if you want the players

methods.name: spawnEntity
methods.description: spawns a new entity into the world

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: case insensitive entity type name string

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: location object where the entity spawns

methods.name: setBlock
methods.description: sets a block at a target location to a material
methods.note: nonblock materials like `"diamond_sword"` cause a runtime error

parameters.name: material
parameters.description: case insensitive vanilla block material name

methods.name: getBlock
methods.description: gets the block material name at a target location

methods.name: fillBlocks
methods.description: fills a 3D rectangular region between two corner locations with a block material

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: starting corner location object or coordinates

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: ending corner location object or coordinates

methods.name: playSound
methods.description: plays a sound effect at a world location visible/audible to everyone around it
methods.note: plays at a fixed location and everyone is able to hear it, unlike `player.playSound` which plays specifically to one player

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: fixed location object where the sound plays

methods.name: spawnParticle
methods.description: spawns particles into the world visible to all players
methods.note: visible to all players
methods.example:
Katton.world().spawnParticle("flame", player.location)
Katton.world().spawnParticle("dust", player.location, count = 20, offset = {"x": 1, "y": 1, "z": 1}, color = "#ff55aa", size = 1.5)
Katton.world().spawnParticle("dust_color_transition", player.location, count = 10, color = "#ff0000", to_color = "#0000ff", size = 2)
Katton.world().spawnParticle("block", player.location, count = 30, material = "diamond_block")
Katton.world().spawnParticle("flame", player.location, direction = {"x": 0, "y": 1, "z": 0}, speed = 0.5)

parameters.name: particle
parameters.description: case insensitive vanilla particle name string

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: how many particles to spawn (ignored if `direction` is used)

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: 0, "y": 0, "z": 0} spread range across axes (capped at +/-16 blocks)

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: hex string, map, or RGB list for dust/transition particles

parameters.name: to_color
parameters.description: end color for dust transition particles

parameters.name: material
parameters.description: block or item material name for block/item particles
